active_family: native joint conditional generator for IV + anchor factors with shared source and transition; mixed-coordinate/state-conditioned variants remain the best-supported path
current_bottleneck: 661a falsified direct 510a lifting to an absolute encoded 38-channel level panel. The shared-source/shared-transition mechanism runs, but empirical-score state decoding is bounded by training support and fails validation anchor factors that drift beyond the training level range. Validation IV level occupancy collapses and joint anchor tails/correlations weaken.
last_result_summary: 661a trained a generalized 510a-style generic empirical-score AR transition over joint38 with a small patch-energy rollout objective. Train-tail IV scored 6/11 with cov90 0.786, daily KS 24/25, level KS 22/25, median-bias 25/25, and max-jump KS 0.171, but failed coverage, conditionality, time_series, cointegration, and regime_coverage. Validation IV scored 4/11 with cov90 0.563, level KS 1/25, median-bias 4/25, and max-jump KS 0.559. Validation joint audit degraded versus 641a/647a: factor KS pass 10/13, q99 pass 6/13, factor-factor correlation shape 0.584, IV-factor shape 0.689, and strong attenuation of absolute correlation magnitudes.
next_step_recommendation: Do not continue absolute-level empirical-score joint lifting. Return to the mixed-coordinate/state-conditioned native joint family or make the 510a trunk operate on movement-from-current coordinates with explicit state conditioning. Keep one shared stochastic model and typed readout/coordinate rules, but avoid separate IV/factor decks or post-hoc calibration.
current_best_note: 510a/392a remain the historical short-frame best learned IV laws at 8/11. For native IV+anchor joint generation, 641a/647a remain more defensible than 661a because they preserve one shared stochastic model while using mixed generated coordinates; 661a is a negative falsifier for absolute-level empirical-score lifting. 656a remains only a diagnostic stress-deck overlay because it is composed post hoc rather than generated by one mechanism.
oracle_feasibility_note: 435a reaches 11/11 only as a validation-future oracle upper bound; it is not a deployable or learned conditional scenario generator.
